root_cause: The canonical Problem Library represented capacity and onboarding but materially underrepresented workforce failure modes such as absence, long-term sickness, workload, attrition, hiring friction, skills gaps, people cost pressure, HR compliance, leadership/team health and workplace safety.
prevention_rule: Every Problem Radar coverage review must explicitly assess finance, sales, operations, technology/data, people/workforce, management and risk domains. Every canonical problem is part of one shared cross-domain problem graph; no domain may create a parallel taxonomy or isolated intelligence model. People signals must be privacy-safe, benchmark-aware and evidence-led.
changes: canonical problem library expanded from 30 to 40 problems
PH-P031 through PH-P040 added as first-class people problems
cross-domain problem graph connects people evidence to finance, operations, sales, knowledge, risk, executive cockpit, opportunity scoring, content/sales and outcome learning
terminal_rule: LIVE_PROVEN requires protected merge plus a ready production deploy whose commit is the merge commit or a proven descendant. This obligation now satisfies that rule.

invariants: PH-P031 through PH-P040 exist exactly once in the canonical Problem Library
people problems keep evidence, action, capability and outcome mappings
external benchmarks remain context rather than tenant proof
no medical diagnosis inference is allowed
executive people evidence defaults to aggregated or team-level signals

production_evidence.ancestry: production commit is 5 commits ahead of and contains the People/HR merge
